caption: The drawing shows an architectural elevation of an altar and its surrounding structure. The altar stands on a set of three brown steps and has rectangular panels decorated with various geometric and floral designs in green, pink, and red. It is centered below three tall, arched niches or window frames, with the middle niche being the tallest. These niches are bordered by vertical green columns with red bases and capitals, and they have ornate, curved moldings at the top. Above the niches, there is a frieze with a green vine-like pattern and a decorative arched gable roof featuring more green decorative elements. The structure is symmetrically designed, with similar window-like frames and moldings on both the lower and upper levels. The background and main structure are rendered in light beige with extensive green decorative detailing. The lower part of the wall on each side of the altar has panels decorated with floral motifs in green and pink colors, divided by vertical strips. The signature “Ethel Dougan 1938” is written near the lower right corner of the drawing. The entire composition is centered on a plain, off-white background.
title: Reredos-Mission San Juan Bautista
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
